#### Description
The `Name` property of `ScheduledEvent` is now the same as when the event was created.

#### Related Issue
Fixes #1674

#### Motivation and Context
Currently a `Guid` string was automatically appended to the scheduled event name, reducing readability of error messages and logs.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No

issue_context.title: Remove Guid string from ScheduledEvent.Name
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
The event name should remain the same as when the event was created.

#### Actual Behavior
Currently a `Guid` string is automatically appended to the scheduled event name, reducing readability of  error messages and logs.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
